title: Caseworth — Free Bootstrap 6 Law Firm & Accountancy Website Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 template for solicitors and accountants — numbered practice index, people with credentials, a filterable published fee table and an enquiry form.
yoastTitle: Caseworth — Free Bootstrap 6 Law Firm & Accountancy Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 law firm and accountancy website template with a filterable fee table, numbered practice index, partner profiles, native details accordions and an enquiry form using Combobox and Datepicker.
intro: Caseworth is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 website template for law firms, solicitors, chartered accountants, tax advisers and professional-services practices generally. It pairs a full firm homepage — practice index, people, published fees, insights and an enquiry form — with a practice area detail page.
note: Professional-services sites trade on typography and credibility rather than photography, so this one is set in a serif on paper-white with hairline rules instead of cards. The Bootstrap 6 pieces doing the work are the new table variants — .table-stacked reflows the published fee table into readable blocks on a phone instead of forcing a horizontal scroll — plus a searchable Combobox for practice area, a Datepicker for deadlines, and native <details> accordions, which replaced the JavaScript accordion entirely in v6.
summary: Caseworth is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 template for law firms, accountants and professional-services practices. The homepage runs a typographic masthead with a plate-style photograph, a ten-item numbered practice index set as a two-column table of contents, partner profiles with credentials, a published fee table with live filtering and .table-stacked mobile reflow, an insights list and an enquiry form using a searchable Combobox and Datepicker. The practice page adds scope, a staged fee table, native details accordions and a sticky contact rail. Serif design language, hairline rules, ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Two pages — firm homepage and a practice area detail page
Published fee table using the new .table-stacked, which reflows to blocks on mobile instead of scrolling
Live fee-table filtering that degrades to a static readable table without JavaScript
Ten-item numbered practice index set as a two-column table of contents
Partner profiles carrying real credentials — SRA, FCA, CTA
Enquiry form with searchable Combobox practice picker and optional Datepicker deadline
Native <details> accordions — v6 removed the JavaScript accordion entirely
Typographic design language: serif throughout, hairline rules, no cards
Staged fee table on the practice page plus a sticky contact rail
Bootstrap 6 vendored at a pinned commit, ESM-only, no build step
